import os

def main():

    parser.add_argument("-p", "--project-root", default=".", help="Path to the project root")
    parser.add_argument("-V", "--version", action="version", version="serpl 0.3.4- (2026-04-20)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    curses.wrapper(lambda stdscr: TUI(stdscr, args.project_root).run())

class TUI:
    def __init__(self, stdscr, project_root):
        self.stdscr = stdscr
        self.project_root = project_root
        self.search_text = ""
        self.replace_text = ""
        self.search_modes = ["Simple", "Match Case", "Match Whole Word", "Match Case Whole Word", "Regex"]
        self.search_mode_idx = 0
        self.replace_modes = ["Simple", "Preserve Case", "Delete Line"]
        self.replace_mode_idx = 0
        self.focused_pane = 0 # 0: Search, 1: Replace, 2: ResultList, 3: Preview
        self.file_matches = []
        self.selected_file_idx = 0
        self.expanded = False
        self.selected_match_idx = 0
        self.notification = None
        self.notification_time = 0
        
        curses.start_color()
        curses.use_default_colors()
        curses.init_pair(1, curses.COLOR_GREEN, -1) # Focused border
        curses.init_pair(2, curses.COLOR_WHITE, -1) # Normal border
        curses.init_pair(3, curses.COLOR_BLUE, -1)  # Selection / Help
        curses.init_pair(4, curses.COLOR_RED, curses.COLOR_BLACK) # Match original (fallback)
        curses.init_pair(5, curses.COLOR_GREEN, curses.COLOR_BLACK) # Match replacement (fallback)
        curses.init_pair(6, curses.COLOR_CYAN, -1) # Line numbers context
        curses.init_pair(7, 8, -1) # Grey context (might not work if 8 is not grey)
        
        # Try to get grey
        if curses.COLORS >= 256:
            curses.init_pair(7, 244, -1) # Grey
            curses.init_pair(8, curses.COLOR_WHITE, 160) # Original: White on Red
            curses.init_pair(9, curses.COLOR_WHITE, 28)  # Replacement: White on Green
        else:
            curses.init_pair(8, curses.COLOR_WHITE, curses.COLOR_RED)
            curses.init_pair(9, curses.COLOR_WHITE, curses.COLOR_GREEN)

    def run(self):
        curses.curs_set(0)
        self.stdscr.nodelay(True)
        while True:
            self.draw()
            try:
                ch = self.stdscr.getch()
            except:
                continue
            if ch == -1:
                import time
                time.sleep(0.01)
                continue
            if ch == curses.KEY_RESIZE:
                continue
            if self.handle_input(ch):
                break

    def draw(self):
        self.stdscr.erase()
        h, w = self.stdscr.getmaxyx()
        
        # Layout
        left_w = int(w * 0.3)
        right_w = w - left_w - 1
        
        # Panes
        self.draw_box(0, 0, 3, left_w, "Search", self.search_text, 0)
        self.draw_box(3, 0, 3, left_w, "Replace", self.replace_text, 1)
        self.draw_result_list(6, 0, h - 7, left_w)
        self.draw_preview(0, left_w, h - 1, right_w)
        self.draw_help(h - 1, w)
        
        if self.notification:
            import time
            if time.time() - self.notification_time > 3:
                self.notification = None
            else:
                self.draw_notification(h, w)

        self.stdscr.refresh()

    def draw_box(self, y, x, h, w, title, content, pane_idx):
        color = curses.color_pair(1) if self.focused_pane == pane_idx else curses.color_pair(2)
        self.stdscr.attron(color)
        self.stdscr.rect(y, x, h - 1, w - 1)
        label = f"[{self.search_modes[self.search_mode_idx]}]" if pane_idx == 0 else f"[{self.replace_modes[self.replace_mode_idx]}]"
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x + 1, f"{title} {label}")
        self.stdscr.attroff(color)
        
        display_content = content
        if pane_idx == 1 and self.replace_modes[self.replace_mode_idx] == "Delete Line":
            display_content = "[Entire line will be deleted]"
        self.stdscr.addstr(y + 1, x + 1, display_content[:w-2])

    def draw_result_list(self, y, x, h, w):
        color = curses.color_pair(1) if self.focused_pane == 2 else curses.color_pair(2)
        self.stdscr.attron(color)
        self.stdscr.rect(y, x, h - 1, w - 1)
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x + 1, "Result List")
        self.stdscr.attroff(color)
        
        for i, fm in enumerate(self.file_matches):
            if y + 1 + i >= y + h - 1: break
            style = curses.A_REVERSE if i == self.selected_file_idx and self.focused_pane == 2 and not self.expanded else curses.A_NORMAL
            if i == self.selected_file_idx and not self.expanded:
                self.stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(3))
            self.stdscr.addstr(y + 1 + i, x + 1, f"{fm['path']} ({len(fm['matches'])})")[:w-2]
            self.stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(3))

    def draw_preview(self, y, x, h, w):
        color = curses.color_pair(1) if self.focused_pane == 3 else curses.color_pair(2)
        self.stdscr.attron(color)
        self.stdscr.rect(y, x, h - 1, w - 1)
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x + 1, "Preview")
        self.stdscr.attroff(color)
        
        if not self.file_matches or self.selected_file_idx >= len(self.file_matches):
            return

        fm = self.file_matches[self.selected_file_idx]
        curr_y = y + 1
        for i, m in enumerate(fm['matches']):
            if curr_y >= y + h - 1: break
            if i > 0:
                self.stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(7))
                self.stdscr.addstr(curr_y, x + 1, "-" * (w - 2))
                self.stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(7))
                curr_y += 1
            
            # Context before

            if line_idx > 0:

                self.stdscr.addstr(curr_y, x + 1, f"{line_idx:4} ")
                self.stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(3))
                self.stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(7))
                self.stdscr.addstr(fm['lines'][line_idx - 1][:w-7])
                self.stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(7))
                curr_y += 1

        self.focused_pane = 0 # 0: Search, 1: Replace, 2: ResultList, 3: Preview
        self.file_matches = []
        self.selected_file_idx = 0
        self.expanded = False
        self.selected_match_idx = 0
        self.notification = None
        self.notification_time = 0
        self.show_confirm = False
        
        curses.start_color()
        curses.use_default_colors()
        curses.init_pair(1, curses.COLOR_GREEN, -1)
        curses.init_pair(2, curses.COLOR_WHITE, -1)
        curses.init_pair(3, curses.COLOR_BLUE, -1)
        if curses.COLORS >= 256:
            curses.init_pair(7, 244, -1)
            curses.init_pair(8, 15, 160)
            curses.init_pair(9, 15, 28)
        else:
            curses.init_pair(7, curses.COLOR_CYAN, -1)
            curses.init_pair(8, curses.COLOR_WHITE, curses.COLOR_RED)
            curses.init_pair(9, curses.COLOR_WHITE, curses.COLOR_GREEN)

    def run(self):
        curses.curs_set(0)
        self.stdscr.nodelay(True)
        self.update_search()
        while True:
            self.draw()
            ch = self.stdscr.getch()
            if ch == -1:
                time.sleep(0.01)
                continue
            if self.handle_input(ch): break

    def draw(self):
        self.stdscr.erase()
        h, w = self.stdscr.getmaxyx()
        left_w = int(w * 0.3)
        right_w = w - left_w
        self.draw_box(0, 0, 3, left_w, "Search", self.search_text, 0)
        self.draw_box(3, 0, 3, left_w, "Replace", self.replace_text, 1)
        self.draw_result_list(6, 0, h - 7, left_w)
        self.draw_preview(0, left_w, h - 1, right_w)
        self.draw_help(h - 1, w)
        if self.notification:
            if time.time() - self.notification_time > 3: self.notification = None
            else: self.draw_notification(h, w)
        if self.show_confirm: self.draw_confirm(h, w)
        self.stdscr.refresh()

    def draw_box(self, y, x, h, w, title, content, pane_idx):
        color = curses.color_pair(1) if self.focused_pane == pane_idx else curses.color_pair(2)
        self.stdscr.attron(color)
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x, "╭" + "─" * (w-2) + "╮")
        self.stdscr.addstr(y+1, x, "│")
        self.stdscr.addstr(y+1, x+w-1, "│")
        self.stdscr.addstr(y+2, x, "╰" + "─" * (w-2) + "╯")
        label = f"[{self.search_modes[self.search_mode_idx]}]" if pane_idx == 0 else f"[{self.replace_modes[self.replace_mode_idx]}]"
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x + 1, f"{title}")
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x + w - len(label) - 1, label)
        self.stdscr.attroff(color)
        display = content
        if pane_idx == 1 and self.replace_modes[self.replace_mode_idx] == "Delete Line":
            display = "[Entire line will be deleted]"
        self.stdscr.addstr(y + 1, x + 1, display[:w-2])

    def draw_result_list(self, y, x, h, w):
        color = curses.color_pair(1) if self.focused_pane == 2 else curses.color_pair(2)
        self.stdscr.attron(color)
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x, "╭Result List" + "─"*(w-13) + "╮")
        for i in range(1, h-1):
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x, "│")
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x+w-1, "│")
        self.stdscr.addstr(y+h-1, x, "╰" + "─" * (w-2) + "╯")
        self.stdscr.attroff(color)
        for i, fm in enumerate(self.file_matches):
            if y + 1 + i >= y + h - 1: break
            if i == self.selected_file_idx and self.focused_pane == 2:
                self.stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(3))
            self.stdscr.addstr(y + 1 + i, x + 1, f"{fm['path']} ({len(fm['matches'])})")[:w-2]
            self.stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(3))

    def draw_preview(self, y, x, h, w):
        color = curses.color_pair(1) if self.focused_pane == 3 else curses.color_pair(2)
        self.stdscr.attron(color)
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x, "╭Preview" + "─"*(w-9) + "╮")
        for i in range(1, h-1):
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x, "│")
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x+w-1, "│")
        self.stdscr.addstr(y+h-1, x, "╰" + "─" * (w-2) + "╯")
        self.stdscr.attroff(color)
        if not self.file_matches: return
        fm = self.file_matches[self.selected_file_idx]
        curr_y = y + 1
        for i, m in enumerate(fm['matches']):
            if curr_y >= y + h - 1: break
            if i > 0:
                self.stdscr.addstr(curr_y, x + 1, "-" * (w - 2), curses.color_pair(7))
                curr_y += 1
            if curr_y >= y + h - 1: break
            l_idx = m['line_number'] - 1
            if l_idx > 0:
                self.stdscr.addstr(curr_y, x + 1, f"{l_idx:4} ", curses.color_pair(3))
                self.stdscr.addstr(fm['lines'][l_idx-1][:w-10], curses.color_pair(7))
                curr_y += 1
            if curr_y >= y + h - 1: break
            self.stdscr.addstr(curr_y, x + 1, ">" if self.expanded and i == self.selected_match_idx else " ")
            self.stdscr.addstr(f"{m['line_number']:4} ", curses.color_pair(1))
            line = m['line_content']
            self.stdscr.addstr(line[:m['start']][:w-15])
            self.stdscr.addstr(line[m['start']:m['end']], curses.color_pair(8))
            if self.replace_modes[self.replace_mode_idx] != "Delete Line":
                self.stdscr.addstr(self.get_replacement(line[m['start']:m['end']]), curses.color_pair(9))
            self.stdscr.addstr(line[m['end']:][:w-40])
            curr_y += 1
            if curr_y >= y + h - 1: break
            if l_idx < len(fm['lines']) - 1:
                self.stdscr.addstr(curr_y, x + 1, f"{l_idx+2:4} ", curses.color_pair(3))
                self.stdscr.addstr(fm['lines'][l_idx+1][:w-10], curses.color_pair(7))
                curr_y += 1

    def draw_help(self, y, w):
        ht = [
            "Help: <Ctrl-b> | Search: <Enter> | Toggle search mode:",
            "Help: <Ctrl-b> | Replace: <C-o> | Toggle replace mode:",
            "Help: <Ctrl-b> | Open File: <Enter> | Replace File: <r>",
            "Help: <Ctrl-b> | Back to list: <Enter> | Replace Line:"
        ]
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, 0, ht[self.focused_pane][:w-1], curses.color_pair(3))

    def handle_input(self, ch):
        if ch == 3 or ch == 4: return True
        if ch == 9: # Tab
            if not self.expanded: self.focused_pane = (self.focused_pane + 1) % 3
        elif ch == 10: # Enter
            if self.focused_pane == 2:
                if self.file_matches: self.expanded, self.focused_pane, self.selected_match_idx = True, 3, 0
            elif self.focused_pane == 3: self.expanded, self.focused_pane = False, 2
            elif self.show_confirm: self.perform_replace_all(); self.show_confirm = False
        elif ch == curses.KEY_BACKSPACE or ch == 127:
            if self.focused_pane == 0: self.search_text = self.search_text[:-1]; self.update_search()
            elif self.focused_pane == 1: self.replace_text = self.replace_text[:-1]
        elif 32 <= ch <= 126:
            c = chr(ch)
            if self.focused_pane == 0: self.search_text += c; self.update_search()
            elif self.focused_pane == 1: self.replace_text += c
            elif self.focused_pane == 2:
                if c == 'j': self.selected_file_idx = (self.selected_file_idx - 1) % len(self.file_matches) if self.file_matches else 0
                elif c == 'k': self.selected_file_idx = (self.selected_file_idx + 1) % len(self.file_matches) if self.file_matches else 0
                elif c == 'r': self.replace_file()
            elif self.focused_pane == 3:
                fm = self.file_matches[self.selected_file_idx]
                if c == 'j': self.selected_match_idx = (self.selected_match_idx - 1) % len(fm['matches'])
                elif c == 'k': self.selected_match_idx = (self.selected_match_idx + 1) % len(fm['matches'])
                elif c == 'r': self.replace_line_match()
        elif ch == 14: # Ctrl-N
            if self.focused_pane == 0: self.search_mode_idx = (self.search_mode_idx + 1) % len(self.search_modes); self.update_search()
            elif self.focused_pane == 1: self.replace_mode_idx = (self.replace_mode_idx + 1) % len(self.replace_modes)
        elif ch == 15: # Ctrl-O
            if not self.search_text: self.set_notif("Search text cannot be empty")
            else: self.show_confirm = True
        return False

    def update_search(self):
        self.file_matches = []
        if not self.search_text: return
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(self.project_root):
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
            for f in sorted(files):
                if f.startswith('.'): continue
                p = os.path.join(root, f)
                try:
                    with open(p, 'r') as file: lines = file.readlines()
                    ms = []
                    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
                        for s, e in self.find_line_matches(l):
                            ms.append({'line_number': i+1, 'line_content': l.rstrip(), 'start': s, 'end': e})
                    if ms: self.file_matches.append({'path': os.path.relpath(p, self.project_root), 'matches': ms, 'lines': [l.rstrip() for l in lines]})
                except: pass
        if self.file_matches: self.selected_file_idx = min(self.selected_file_idx, len(self.file_matches)-1)

    def find_line_matches(self, line):
        mode = self.search_modes[self.search_mode_idx]
        if mode == "Regex":
            try: return [(m.start(), m.end()) for m in re.finditer(self.search_text, line, re.I)]
            except: return []
        cs, ww = "Match Case" in mode, "Whole Word" in mode
        s, l = (self.search_text, line) if cs else (self.search_text.lower(), line.lower())
        res, start = [], 0
        while True:
            pos = l.find(s, start)
            if pos == -1: break
            end = pos + len(s)
            match = True
            if ww:
                if pos > 0 and (line[pos-1].isalnum() or line[pos-1] == '_'): match = False
                if end < len(line) and (line[end].isalnum() or line[end] == '_'): match = False
            if match: res.append((pos, end))
            start = end if s else pos + 1
            if not s: break
        return res

    def get_replacement(self, orig):
        mode = self.replace_modes[self.replace_mode_idx]
        if mode == "Simple": return self.replace_text
        if mode == "Preserve Case":
            if orig.isupper(): return self.replace_text.upper()
            if orig and orig[0].isupper(): return self.replace_text.capitalize()
            return self.replace_text.lower()
        return ""

    def replace_file(self):
        fm = self.file_matches[self.selected_file_idx]
        self._replace_in_path(fm['path'])
        self.update_search()
        self.set_notif("File replacement completed successfully")

    def replace_line_match(self):
        fm = self.file_matches[self.selected_file_idx]
        m = fm['matches'][self.selected_match_idx]
        p = os.path.join(self.project_root, fm['path'])
        with open(p, 'r') as f: lines = f.readlines()
        if self.replace_modes[self.replace_mode_idx] == "Delete Line": lines.pop(m['line_number']-1)
        else:
            l = lines[m['line_number']-1]
            lines[m['line_number']-1] = l[:m['start']] + self.get_replacement(l[m['start']:m['end']]) + l[m['end']:]
        with open(p, 'w') as f: f.writelines(lines)
        self.update_search()
        self.set_notif("Line replacement completed successfully")

    def perform_replace_all(self):
        paths = [fm['path'] for fm in self.file_matches]
        for p in paths: self._replace_in_path(p)
        self.update_search()
        self.set_notif("Replacement completed successfully")

    def _replace_in_path(self, rel_p):
        p = os.path.join(self.project_root, rel_p)
        with open(p, 'r') as f: lines = f.readlines()
        new_lines = []
        for l in lines:
            ms = self.find_line_matches(l)
            if not ms: new_lines.append(l)
            elif self.replace_modes[self.replace_mode_idx] == "Delete Line": continue
            else:
                nl, last = "", 0
                for s, e in ms:
                    nl += l[last:s] + self.get_replacement(l[s:e])
                    last = e
                nl += l[last:]
                new_lines.append(nl)
        with open(p, 'w') as f: f.writelines(new_lines)

    def set_notif(self, m): self.notification, self.notification_time = m, time.time()
    def draw_notification(self, h, w):
        self.stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(2))
        self.stdscr.rect(h//2-2, w//2-20, 3, 40)
        self.stdscr.addstr(h//2-1, w//2-19, self.notification[:38])
    def draw_confirm(self, h, w):
        self.stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(2))
        self.stdscr.rect(h//2-4, w//2-30, 8, 60)
        self.stdscr.addstr(h//2-2, w//2-28, "This action will modify the files in this directory.")
        self.stdscr.addstr(h//2-1, w//2-28, "Are you sure you want to continue?")
        self.stdscr.addstr(h//2+2, w//2-10, "Continue", curses.A_REVERSE)
        self.stdscr.addstr(h//2+2, w//2+2, "Cancel")

if __name__ == "__main__": main()
